Are you an experienced Quality Manager ready to lead change in a high-tech manufacturing environment? Xelvin is looking for a Quality Manager to join an internationally operating technology company in the Eindhoven region. In this strategic leadership role, you will drive quality excellence, lead a multidisciplinary team of engineers, and play a key role in supporting the company's growth ambitions within the semiconductor industry. If you thrive in complex technical environments, enjoy leading people through transformation, and are passionate about continuous improvement, this could be your next career move. About the role Our client is a leading supplier of highly engineered precision components used in advanced technological applications. Operating within the global semiconductor supply chain, the company develops and manufactures critical products that contribute to some of the world's most innovative technologies. As Quality Manager, you will be responsible for leading a team of approximately ten quality professionals, ranging from experienced specialists to ambitious junior engineers. You will ensure product and process quality standards are maintained while driving organizational improvements, fostering collaboration, and strengthening a culture of operational excellence. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A challenging leadership role within a rapidly growing high-tech organization. Competitive salary based on experience and expertise. Performance-based bonus scheme. 27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV days. Excellent pension and secondary benefits package. Opportunities for professional growth, training, and career development. An international work environment with colleagues from over 25 nationalities. A culture focused on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Regular company events, sports activities, and social gatherings. Functie-eisen To succeed in this position, you bring: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or another relevant

technical discipline. Proven leadership experience within quality management in a high-tech manufacturing environment. Experience within the semiconductor industry or a similarly demanding technical sector. Strong knowledge of quality methodologies and continuous improvement tools such as Six Sigma, DMAIC, PDCA, SPC, 8D, APQP, and PPAP. Experience with quality management systems and QESH standards. Demonstrated experience in change management and organizational development. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Hier kom je te werken Our client is an internationally recognized technology manufacturer specializing in high-precision engineered components for demanding industrial applications. Their products play a critical role in advanced manufacturing environments where reliability, accuracy, and consistency are essential. Driven by innovation and continuous improvement, the company serves leading customers worldwide and operates within one of the fastest-growing sectors of the global technology market. Employees benefit from a collaborative, multicultural environment where technical expertise, personal development, and teamwork are highly valued.

Are you technically skilled and do you enjoy working on complex technical assemblies in a modern production environment? For an innovative high-tech company in the Tilburg region, we are looking for a Module Assembly Operator. In this role, you will work on high-quality modules where precision, craftsmanship, and quality are central within a technically advanced production environment where complex three-dimensional modules are assembled, welded, and tested according to strict quality standards.

As a Module Assembly Operator, you will be responsible for assembling and welding complex modules. You will work based on technical drawings and execute work orders according to planning. Your tasks include TIG welding components, including welding with orbital welding heads, and assembling parts into complete modules.

In addition, you will test, measure, and inspect the modules to ensure they meet all required quality and safety standards. You will operate machines, set them up, adjust them when necessary, and perform first-line maintenance to ensure the production process runs smoothly.

Besides the assembly and welding activities, you will carry out repair work and contribute to pilot projects and the development of new products. You will digitally register completed work orders in the system and support colleagues by sharing knowledge and providing instructions when needed.

Within this role, you are also expected to actively contribute ideas for improving processes and working methods. This is a technical and responsible position where technical insight, three-dimensional thinking, independence, and teamwork come together within a modern high-tech production environment.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings
- Strong spatial and technical 3D insight
- Good command of English
- Experience with metalworking
- Minimum MBO level 3 education in a technical field (preferably mechanical engineering or mechatronics)

jobs.description:
Are you an Exterior Engineer, CAD Engineer or Product Design Engineer based in Portugal and ready to work on unique, high-end technical projects? Xelvin is looking for an engineer who wants to relocate to the Netherlands and contribute to the exterior design and engineering of luxury superyachts. In this role, you will translate design ideas and customer requirements into smart, manufacturable and high-quality technical solutions. You will work on exterior elements such as railings, sliding door systems, sunshade systems, masts, decorative elements, exterior panels and other visible parts of the yacht. This role combines technical engineering, design sensitivity and practical manufacturability. The exterior of a superyacht must not only function perfectly, but also look flawless. What you will do As an Exterior Engineer, you will be part of a multidisciplinary engineering team. You will work closely with project engineers, architects, production teams and external partners. Your responsibilities include: Creating and developing 3D models for exterior yacht components. Translating design concepts into practical and manufacturable solutions. Engineering exterior parts such as railings, doors, sunshade systems, panels, masts and decorative elements. Checking technical feasibility, quality, cost efficiency and production requirements. Working with other disciplines to make sure exterior systems fit with the overall yacht design. Supporting production and suppliers with clear technical information. Identifying technical risks and proposing smart improvements. Contributing ideas to improve quality, efficiency and manufacturability. Monitoring the technical consistency of your scope within the project. You will work on custom-built projects where every detail must match the overall design and quality standard. What Xelvin offers you A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A gross monthly salary between €3,700 and €5,500, depending on experience.

Relocation support from Portugal to the Netherlands. Help with documentation, registration and practical relocation matters. Guidance from our housing consultant. Paid holidays and holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Training and development opportunities. Personal guidance from Xelvin during the full relocation process. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for engineers with experience in product design, industrial design, shipbuilding, metalwork, exterior systems or high-end technical engineering. You have: A technical education such as Curso Técnico Superior Profissional, Licenciatura, Mestrado or comparable experience. A background in Industrial Design, Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, Naval Architecture, Shipbuilding, Furniture/Interior Technology or a related technical field. At least 3 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: industrial product design; shipbuilding or marine engineering; yacht interiors or yacht exteriors; metal structures, aluminium or stainless steel components; high-end custom engineering. Strong experience with 2D and 3D CAD software. Experience with SolidWorks, Rhino, AutoCAD, Inventor, Siemens NX, CATIA, Fusion 360 or similar software. Good understanding of manufacturability, materials and technical detailing. A strong eye for shape, finish and visual quality. Good English communication skills. Motivation to relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands. Dutch is not required. Willingness to learn Dutch over time is a plus. Hier kom je te werken Our client is a leading organization in the Dutch superyacht industry. The company designs, engineers and builds custom-made luxury yachts for international clients. Every project is unique and requires close collaboration between design, engineering, production, suppliers and specialist partners. The working environment is technical, international and quality-driven, with a strong focus on craftsmanship, innovation and tailor-made solutions.
